jog.not_while_a_job_is_running: Not while a job is running
jog.move_with_the_arrows_x_y: Move with the arrows (X/Y) and PgUp / PgDn (Z) while active
jog.release_the_arrows_and_pgup_pgdn: Release the arrows and PgUp / PgDn
jog.tap_a_key_one_step_hold: Tap a key = one step. Hold it = continuous until released. Turns itself off when the jog is closed or the window is left.
jog.no_connection_with_the_system_service: No connection with the System service (the Duet must be in SBC mode).
jog.the_service_does_not_allow_jogging: the service does not allow jogging right now
jog.confirmed_move_the_jog_again_valid: Confirmed. Move the jog again (valid for 60 s).
jog.the_system_sends_the_jog_to: The system sends the jog to the Duet through DSF: the board in SBC mode, attached to the system. Without SBC mode, or without the System service (WorkshopService plugin) running, there is no channel to send it through. The service is installed and started in Settings > Plugins; which channel each part uses is chosen in System service.
jog.to_move_anyway_confirm_with_a_2: {reason}. To move anyway, confirm with a double tap.
jog.it_does_not_move_not_homed: It does not move: {axes} not homed. Home it, or turn on Move without limits.
jog.not_homed_they_do_not_move: Not homed: {axes} (they do not move: home them or use Move without limits)
jog.the_duet_is_not_in_sbc: the Duet is not in SBC mode (the jog needs the system)
jog.the_system_service_is_missing: the system service is missing (WorkshopService plugin)
jog.the_system_service_is_stopped_plugins: the system service is stopped (Plugins > WorkshopService)
jog.jog_stop_does_not_cut_the: Jog stop (does not cut the motors, no rehome needed)
jog.real_emergency_m112_one_tap: Real EMERGENCY (M112) -- one tap, no confirmation
jog.the_usual_x_y_circle_with: The usual X/Y circle, with soft snapping to the axis
jog.x_and_y_as_separate_sliders: X and Y as separate sliders -- only one axis at a time, guaranteed
jog.adv_no_sections: No sections to show for this machine.
jog.adv_all_hidden: All the sections are hidden. Turn them on in the gear > Sections of the Advanced tab.
jog.adv_log_empty: Nothing yet: the actions of the jog appear here.
jog.adv_machine_not_free: The machine is not free: a job, a live job or a block of the service.
jog.adv_sections_hint: For the whole machine. Show = it appears; the arrows change the order. Some sections only exist in some modes.
jog.use_a_button_that_already_exists: Use a button that already exists (bar)
jog.edit_macro_file_tip: Opens the file of the chosen macro in the DWC editor.
jog.state_title: State of the button (optional): it lights up while this value matches
jog.state_tip: Path in the object model of the machine and the value that means ON, for example global.light and true, or state.machineMode and Laser.
jog.state_off_ph: Macro or G-code to turn it off (optional)
jog.state_now_unknown: Now: no value at that path
jog.no_buttons_yet_new_button: No buttons yet: make them in Settings (gear) > Macro buttons.
jog.tap_move_distance_hold_move_continuously: Tap: move -distance. Hold: move continuously towards - until released (slider speed)
Tap: move +distance. Hold: move continuously towards + until released (slider speed)
jog.probe_help: Measures with the Z probe the height of the surface under the head (G30 S-1): it lowers Z until it touches and says the height. It changes no zero. Double tap.
jog.probe_result: The probe touched at Z {z} mm (no zero was changed).
jog.role_view_only: View only: your role does not move the machine here. STOP is always available.
jog.sign_in_needed: You are not signed in. Sign in with your name and PIN to move the machine.

avConsole.title: Console
avConsole.hint: Up and down arrows: history. Several commands separated by ; or new lines are sent one by one and it stops if one fails. M112 and M999 are not accepted here.
avConsole.rejected: {code} is not accepted in the console. Use the emergency stop of the jog.
avConsole.blocked: Not sent, the machine is not free: {code}
avConsole.log_empty: Nothing to show with these filters.

avAxis.title: Control per axis and per mode
avAxis.tool_hint: RRF runs the tool change with its tfree, tpre and tpost macros.
avAxis.no_fire: The jog does not turn the laser on from here.
avAxis.off_blocked: Could not turn off from the jog ({code}): the machine is not free. Turn it off from the DWC console or with the emergency stop.
avAxis.why_over_limit: The move would leave the limits of the axis.
avAxis.why_heater_fault: The heater of the tool does not respond.
avAxis.why_cold: Heater is cold: {temp} C, minimum {min} C.
avAxis.why_rpm_no_limit: The model does not report the spindle maximum.

free.i_understand_the_risks_and_i: I understand the risks and I'm watching the machine
free.the_backup_on_the_board_is: The backup on the board is missing: without it, if the system goes down with the mode on, the limits don't come back by themselves.
free.with_low_current_z_may_drop: With low current Z may drop under its own weight: don't lower it unless you know your Z holds.
free.less_current_less_force_if_it: Less current = less force: if it crashes, the motor skips steps instead of forcing the machine.
free.on_homed_axes_it_never_goes: On HOMED axes it never goes past the limits plus this margin. Without homing there's no known position.
free.if_you_don_t_move_anything: If you don't move anything for this long, the mode turns off and everything goes back to normal.
free.requires_x_y_z_homing_only: Requires X/Y/Z homing. Only lets you go past the limits up to the margin: the position is always known.
free.moves_axes_without_homing_and_beyond: Moves axes without homing and beyond the limits. Without homing the position is unknown: speed, current and crash detection protect the machine.
free.in_laser_mode_the_jog_always: Only in Laser mode the jog adds S0 to its moves: the laser doesn't turn on.
free.keep_your_hand_near_the_emergency: Keep your hand near the EMERGENCY STOP and watch the machine the whole time.
free.only_moves_from_the_jog_the: Only moves from the jog, the console and the DWC movement panel are accepted. If a job (from a file or live) or another macro arrives, it is rejected, the mode turns off and a warning tells you to check.
free.the_drivers_stall_detection_only_works: The drivers' stall detection only works above a certain speed: slowly it does NOT detect. At low speed the reduced current is what protects the machine.
free.an_axis_that_isn_t_homed: An axis that isn't homed does NOT know where it is: it can reach the physical end and crash.
free.while_it_s_on_the_travel: While it's on, the travel limits (M208) and the homing requirement are OFF.
free.check_the_machine_before_going_on: Check the machine before going on. Home it: the position may have been lost.
free.no_backup_on_the_board_daemon: No backup on the board (daemon.g): if the system goes down, the limits don't come back by themselves.
free.turns_itself_off_if_there_is: Turns itself off if there is no movement
free.turns_itself_off_after_s_without: Turns itself off after {s} s without movement
free.stall_not_detected_it_moves_at: Stall: NOT detected (it moves at {v} mm/s, it detects from {c})
free.crash_in_motors: The sensitivity of the crash detection is edited in Motors.

jog2.type_at_least_one_value_x: Type at least one value (X, Y or Z).
jog2.tap_an_arrow_one_step_hold: Tap an arrow = one step. Hold it = continuous move until released (starts smoothly).
jog2.knob_z_home_step_advanced_tabs: Knob, Z, Step tab, macro buttons and Move without limits
jog2.go_to_zero_xy_help: Go to the zero X0 Y0 of the active zone: Z is raised before moving. Double tap.

position.slowly_goes_down_to_z0_of: Slowly goes down to Z0 of the active work area (contact); it asks for confirmation in a dialog
position.raises_z_and_takes_y_to: Raises Z and takes Y to Y0 of the active work area
position.raises_z_and_takes_x_to: Raises Z and takes X to X0 of the active work area

settings.macro_buttons_what: Here you make the buttons of the jog: pick a button that already exists in the bar, a macro of the machine (macros folder) or type a G-code. They are saved on the machine, so every screen and phone shows the same ones. < > order them and Delete (double tap) removes them.
settings.macro_buttons_not_ready: The jog is not ready yet: open it once and come back to this sheet.
settings.factory_values_of_this_design_loaded: Factory values of this design loaded (Save is still needed).
settings.tap_one_step_of_the_chosen: Tap = one step of the chosen distance; hold = continuous movement at the jog speed. They also work in no-limits mode.
settings.this_machine_only_has_x_y: This machine only has X, Y and Z. If you add an axis in config.g (M584 U..., A...), it shows up here and in the Step tab with tap / hold +/-.
settings.only_on_this_screen_the_knob: Only on this screen. The knob, Z, the speed and the stop are always visible.
settings.only_on_this_screen_in_option: Only on this screen. In option 2 the tabs, sections and extra axes are inside More. The knob, Z, the speed and the stop are always visible.
settings.otherwise_it_stays_inside_more_as: Otherwise it stays inside More as usual. The warnings, the blinking and the safeguards are the same.
settings.show_move_without_limits_under_the: Show Move without limits under the stop
settings.large_numbers_in_the_work_area: Large numbers in the work area or the machine (in Laser mode also pointer or laser), go to zero for each axis, limits and speed reached.
settings.show_the_position_above_the_controls: Show the position above the controls
settings.now_the_factory_ones_of_this_2: Now: the factory ones of this option (knob, sliders and Z slider). Anything you change applies only to this option.
settings.now_the_factory_ones_of_this: Now: the factory ones of this option (arrows and Z buttons). Anything you change applies only to this option.
settings.they_only_apply_to_this_option: They only apply to this option. Only one is chosen for X and Y and only one for Z.
settings.only_the_keys_are_drawn_on: Only the keys are drawn on screen (arrows, PgUp and PgDn), with no knob, sliders or buttons. It only moves after tapping Activate keyboard, and turns itself off when the jog is closed or the window is left.
settings.z_slider_with_arrows: With arrows for X/Y, Z uses buttons: a slider next to the arrows makes no sense
settings.with_the_keyboard_pgup_raises_pgdn: With the keyboard: PgUp raises, PgDn lowers
settings.keyboard_this_screen_is_a_touchscreen_2: Keyboard: this screen is a touchscreen and has no keyboard.
settings.keyboard_this_screen_is_a_touchscreen: Keyboard: this screen is a touchscreen and has no keyboard. The factory controls of this design are used here.
settings.at_least_one_control_for_x: At least one control for X/Y and one for Z must remain.
settings.option_1_knob_z_and_home: Option 1: knob, Z and Home / Step / Advanced tabs. Each option keeps its own settings.
settings.option_2_large_position_arrows_tap: Option 2: large position, arrows (tap = one step, hold = smooth continuous), Go to (numbers) and the stop at the bottom. The knob and everything from option 1 stay in More. Each option keeps its own settings.
settings.show_it_is_displayed_open_it: Show = it is displayed. Open = it starts expanded. The arrows change the order inside Advanced.
settings.from_the_machine_they_apply_to: From the MACHINE: they apply to all screens (sys/workshop/config/jog.json, the jog backend picks it up in about 2 s).
settings.what_the_knob_gives_at_full: What the knob gives at full deflection with the speed control at 100 %. It never exceeds the axis maximum on the board (M203).
settings.z_at_full_this_percentage_of: Z at full = this percentage of the X/Y speed (Z is still limited by its M203).
settings.1_linear_half_the_knob_half: 1 = linear (half the knob = half the speed). Higher = finer control near the centre.
settings.how_far_the_knob_must_move: How far the knob must move from the centre before it starts.
settings.this_screen_only_the_distances_of: This screen only. The distances of the Step tab (mm), separated by commas. Up to 12.
settings.same_as_a_a_applied_at: Same as A- / A+ (applied at once).
settings.the_double_tap_confirmations_of_the: The double-tap confirmations of the buttons that MOVE the machine cannot be turned off (safety).
settings.the_machine_part_was_not_saved: The machine part was not saved: {err}
settings.zoom_in_bar: Show the zoom (A- / A+) in the bar, next to the gear

main.opens_the_floating_jog_panel_when: Opens the floating jog panel. When closing it (here or with the "-" of the panel), if there was a held movement (knob, Z or keyboard) it stops first and only then closes; the keyboard control also turns off. It does not stop any global process nor affect other screens.

startup_jog.g_failsafe_desc: The safety net that stops the mode if the page stops answering.
startup_jog.failsafe: Safety macro of the mode without limits
startup_jog.failsafe_tip: A macro of the board that turns the mode off by itself if the page dies, called from sys/daemon.g.
startup_jog.failsafe_no_daemon: installed; the line in daemon.g is added when you first turn the mode on
startup_jog.failsafe_none: the macro is not on the board
startup_jog.failsafe_what: A macro on the board plus a line in sys/daemon.g.
startup_jog.failsafe_for: If the page or the network dies while you move without limits, the board turns the mode off by itself.
startup_jog.failsafe_missing: Do not use the mode without limits until it is there: reinstall the Jog plugin so it copies the macro.
startup_jog.modal_sub: What the Jog needs from your machine
startup_jog.first_intro: Before using the jog on your machine, get the safety stop of the jog without limits ready.
startup_jog.first_ready: Everything is ready. Come back here if you change something on the machine.
